title: Generated multi-exam question set
description: Shape of web/src/content/questions.generated.json, produced from the known list of seed migrations (sql/002-sql/004 in Story 1; sql/005 added in Story 2). Mirrored by the Zod schema in web/src/content/schema.ts, which both the generator and the loader use. Supersedes specs/001-static-quiz's single-exam version of this schema.

_generated.description: Provenance banner. Its presence is what marks this file as machine-produced.

source.description: Describes the configured seed-file list, not a single path, since this file is now produced from several seed migrations.

warning.const: GENERATED FILE — DO NOT EDIT. Edit the source seed migration(s) and regenerate.

exams.description: One entry per configured exam, in the generator's source-list order (research.md R2). Adding an exam appends here; it never reorders existing entries.

examName.description: Display name, from the generator's known source list — not derived from question content.

questionNumber.description: Source numbering, unique WITHIN this exam's `questions` array only — the same number may recur in a different exam entry (FR-008). Used for display and traceability, never for navigation.

domainNumber.description: Scoped per exam. Not bounded to 8 as in the single-exam (001) version of this schema — CCAR-F/Fv2 have 5 domains, CCAR-P has 7, CCDV-F has 8.

format.description: scenario_matching is a Story 2 value (CCAR-P only). No Story 1 generator run produces it.

selectCount.description: For scenario_matching: the number of sub-scenarios requiring classification (FR-011).

questionText.description: For scenario_matching, embeds the numbered sub-scenario list as part of the prose (matches the seed's row-level representation, per sql/001's v2 header comment).

options.description: For scenario_matching, this is the one shared classification-choice set applied to every sub-scenario.

correctAnswers.description: multiple_choice/multiple_response: an unordered set, stored sorted, uniqueItems enforced (see allOf below). scenario_matching: POSITIONAL — index i is the correct classification for sub-scenario i — and NOT unique-constrained; the real CCAR-P data legitimately repeats a letter in every one of its five scenario_matching questions (research.md R4).

then.$comment: Deliberately no uniqueItems constraint here — duplicates are valid for this format.

$comment: Invariants not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by the generator instead, failing the build on violation: (1) selectCount === correctAnswers.length for every format; (2) every key in correctAnswers exists in that question's options; (3) questionNumber is unique within its own examEntry.questions, checked per exam, not globally; (4) examCode is unique across the exams array; (5) generation is all-or-nothing across every configured exam (FR-007) — a single invalid row anywhere fails the whole run and writes no file.
